question: What was the total revenue across all sales?
sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM fact_sales

question: How many distinct customers made at least one purchase?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM fact_sales WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL

question: How many orders (distinct invoices) were placed?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT invoice) FROM fact_sales

question: What are the timestamps of the first and the last sale in the data?
sql: SELECT MIN(invoice_date) AS first_sale, MAX(invoice_date) AS last_sale FROM fact_sales

question: How many cancelled invoices are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT invoice) FROM fact_cancellations

question: What was total revenue in calendar year 2010?
sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM fact_sales WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) = 2010

question: What are the top 5 countries by revenue, and how much revenue did each generate?
sql: SELECT country, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM fact_sales GROUP BY country ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: What was total revenue in each calendar year?
sql: SELECT d.year, SUM(s.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM fact_sales s JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key GROUP BY d.year ORDER BY d.year

question: What are the 10 best-selling products by revenue? Give stock code, description and revenue.
sql: SELECT p.stock_code, p.description, SUM(s.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM fact_sales s JOIN dim_product p ON s.stock_code = p.stock_code GROUP BY p.stock_code, p.description ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10

question: What is the average order value, where an order's value is the total revenue of its invoice?
sql: SELECT AVG(invoice_total) AS average_order_value FROM (SELECT invoice, SUM(revenue) AS invoice_total FROM fact_sales GROUP BY invoice) AS order_totals

question: Which customer has spent the most in total, and how much?
sql: SELECT customer_id, SUM(revenue) AS total_spent FROM fact_sales GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is total revenue by day of the week?
sql: SELECT d.day_name, SUM(s.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM fact_sales s JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key GROUP BY d.day_of_week, d.day_name ORDER BY d.day_of_week

question: What was the revenue in each month of 2011?
sql: SELECT d.month_name, SUM(s.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM fact_sales s JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.year = 2011 GROUP BY d.month, d.month_name ORDER BY d.month

question: Which country has the largest total value of cancelled items (as a positive amount), and what is that value?
sql: SELECT country, ABS(SUM(revenue)) AS total_cancelled_value FROM fact_cancellations GROUP BY country ORDER BY total_cancelled_value DESC LIMIT 1

question: On average, how many distinct products are on a single order?
sql: SELECT AVG(product_count) FROM (SELECT invoice, COUNT(DISTINCT stock_code) AS product_count FROM fact_sales GROUP BY invoice) AS subquery

question: How many customers placed exactly one order?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM fact_sales GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT invoice) = 1) AS single_order_customers

question: Which calendar month had the highest revenue, and what was it?
sql: SELECT d.month_name, d.year, SUM(s.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM fact_sales s JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key GROUP BY d.year, d.month, d.month_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1

question: For each month from February 2011 to November 2011, what was the percentage change in revenue versus the previous month?
sql: WITH monthly_revenue AS (SELECT d.year, d.month, SUM(s.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM fact_sales s JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.year = 2011 AND d.month BETWEEN 1 AND 11 GROUP BY d.year, d.month), revenue_with_lag AS (SELECT year, month, total_revenue, LAG(total_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY year, month) AS prev_month_revenue FROM monthly_revenue) SELECT year, month, ((total_revenue - prev_month_revenue) / NULLIF(prev_month_revenue, 0)) * 100 AS pct_change FROM revenue_with_lag WHERE month >= 2 ORDER BY year, month

question: For each of the 3 countries with the most revenue, what is its single best-selling product by revenue (stock code and revenue)?
sql: WITH country_revenue AS (SELECT country, SUM(revenue) as total_revenue FROM fact_sales GROUP BY country ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 3), product_sales AS (SELECT country, stock_code, SUM(revenue) as product_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY SUM(revenue) DESC) as rank FROM fact_sales WHERE country IN (SELECT country FROM country_revenue) GROUP BY country, stock_code) SELECT country, stock_code, product_revenue FROM product_sales WHERE rank = 1

question: What percentage of total revenue comes from the top 10% of customers by revenue?
sql: WITH customer_revenue AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(revenue) AS total_customer_revenue FROM fact_sales GROUP BY customer_id), ranked_customers AS (SELECT total_customer_revenue, NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY total_customer_revenue DESC) as decile FROM customer_revenue), total_revenue AS (SELECT SUM(total_customer_revenue) as grand_total FROM customer_revenue) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN decile = 1 THEN total_customer_revenue ELSE 0 END) / MAX(grand_total) * 100 AS top_decile_revenue_percentage FROM ranked_customers, total_revenue

question: Among customers who bought in both 2010 and 2011, how many spent less in 2011 than in 2010?
sql: WITH yearly_spend AS (SELECT customer_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) AS yr, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM fact_sales WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) IN (2010, 2011) GROUP BY customer_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)), customer_comparison AS (SELECT customer_id, MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2010 THEN total_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS spend_2010, MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2011 THEN total_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS spend_2011 FROM yearly_spend GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT yr) = 2) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_comparison WHERE spend_2011 < spend_2010

question: By what percentage did revenue in Q1 2011 change compared with Q1 2010?
sql: WITH quarterly_revenue AS (SELECT d.year, SUM(s.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM fact_sales s JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.quarter = 1 AND d.year IN (2010, 2011) GROUP BY d.year) SELECT ((MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2011 THEN total_revenue END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2010 THEN total_revenue END)) / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2010 THEN total_revenue END), 0)) * 100 AS revenue_percentage_change FROM quarterly_revenue

question: Of the customers who made a purchase in 2010, what percentage also made a purchase in 2011?
sql: WITH customers_2010 AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM fact_sales WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) = 2010), customers_2011 AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM fact_sales WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) = 2011) SELECT (COUNT(c2011.customer_id)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(c2010.customer_id), 0)) * 100 AS percentage_retained FROM customers_2010 c2010 LEFT JOIN customers_2011 c2011 ON c2010.customer_id = c2011.customer_id

question: For each of the 3 customers with the highest total revenue, when were their first and last purchases?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_invoice_date, c.last_invoice_date FROM dim_customer c JOIN (SELECT customer_id, SUM(revenue) as total_revenue FROM fact_sales GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 3) top_customers ON c.customer_id = top_customers.customer_id

question: What was the cumulative (running total) revenue at the end of each month of 2011?
sql: WITH monthly_revenue AS (SELECT d.month_start, SUM(s.revenue) AS monthly_rev FROM fact_sales s JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.year = 2011 GROUP BY d.month_start) SELECT month_start, SUM(monthly_rev) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS cumulative_revenue FROM monthly_revenue ORDER BY month_start

question: Among products sold in both 2010 and 2011, which 5 had the largest revenue increase from 2010 to 2011? Give stock code and the increase.
sql: WITH yearly_revenue AS (SELECT stock_code, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) = 2010 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS rev_2010, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) = 2011 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS rev_2011 FROM fact_sales WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) IN (2010, 2011) GROUP BY stock_code) SELECT stock_code, (rev_2011 - rev_2010) AS revenue_increase FROM yearly_revenue WHERE rev_2010 > 0 AND rev_2011 > 0 ORDER BY revenue_increase DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the median order value, where an order's value is the total revenue of its invoice?
sql: WITH order_totals AS (SELECT invoice, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM fact_sales GROUP BY invoice) SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_revenue) AS median_order_value FROM order_totals

question: What was our net revenue in 2011 after cancellations?
sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) AS net_revenue FROM (SELECT revenue FROM fact_sales WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) = 2011 UNION ALL SELECT revenue FROM fact_cancellations WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) = 2011) AS combined_revenue

question: Which product was returned the most, by units, and how many units came back?

question: What share of 2011 revenue came from customers who had already bought from us in 2010?

question: Among countries with at least £10,000 of revenue in 2010, which grew revenue by more than 50% from 2010 to 2011?
sql: WITH yearly_revenue AS (SELECT country, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) AS yr, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM fact_sales WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) IN (2010, 2011) GROUP BY country, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)), revenue_2010 AS (SELECT country, total_revenue FROM yearly_revenue WHERE yr = 2010 AND total_revenue >= 10000), revenue_2011 AS (SELECT country, total_revenue FROM yearly_revenue WHERE yr = 2011) SELECT r10.country FROM revenue_2010 r10 JOIN revenue_2011 r11 ON r10.country = r11.country WHERE r11.total_revenue > r10.total_revenue * 1.5

question: By what percentage did revenue for September to November 2011 change compared with September to November 2010?

sql: WITH top_customers AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(revenue) as total_revenue FROM fact_sales GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 3) SELECT tc.customer_id, tc.total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT fc.invoice) as cancelled_invoice_count FROM top_customers tc LEFT JOIN fact_cancellations fc ON tc.customer_id = fc.customer_id GROUP BY tc.customer_id, tc.total_revenue

question: For sales to France, how many orders were placed and how many invoices were cancelled?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.invoice) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT c.invoice) AS total_cancellations FROM fact_sales s FULL OUTER JOIN fact_cancellations c ON s.invoice = c.invoice WHERE s.country = 'France' OR c.country = 'France'

question: Among countries with at least £10,000 of revenue in 2010, which grew revenue by more than 50% from 2010 to 2011?
sql: WITH yearly_revenue AS (SELECT country, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) AS yr, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM fact_sales WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) IN (2010, 2011) GROUP BY country, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)), revenue_2010 AS (SELECT country, total_revenue FROM yearly_revenue WHERE yr = 2010 AND total_revenue >= 10000), revenue_2011 AS (SELECT country, total_revenue FROM yearly_revenue WHERE yr = 2011) SELECT r10.country FROM revenue_2010 r10 JOIN revenue_2011 r11 ON r10.country = r11.country WHERE r11.total_revenue > r10.total_revenue * 1.5

question: By what percentage did revenue for September to November 2011 change compared with September to November 2010?
sql: WITH period_revenue AS (SELECT CASE WHEN d.year = 2010 THEN '2010' WHEN d.year = 2011 THEN '2011' END as period, SUM(s.revenue) as total_revenue FROM fact_sales s JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.month BETWEEN 9 AND 11 AND d.year IN (2010, 2011) GROUP BY d.year) SELECT ((MAX(CASE WHEN period = '2011' THEN total_revenue END) - MAX(CASE WHEN period = '2010' THEN total_revenue END)) / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN period = '2010' THEN total_revenue END), 0)) * 100 as percentage_change FROM period_revenue

question: How many customers who bought in the first half of 2011 (January to June) did not buy again in the second half (July to December)?
sql: WITH h1_customers AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM fact_sales WHERE invoice_date >= '2011-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2011-07-01'), h2_customers AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM fact_sales WHERE invoice_date >= '2011-07-01' AND invoice_date < '2012-01-01') SELECT COUNT(*) FROM h1_customers WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM h2_customers)

question: Which month of 2011 brought in the most new customers (first-ever purchase), and how many?
sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(first_invoice_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(customer_id) AS new_customer_count FROM dim_customer WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM first_invoice_date) = 2011 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY new_customer_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many active customers did we have in November 2011?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM fact_sales WHERE invoice_date >= '2011-11-01' AND invoice_date < '2011-12-01'

question: What was the average revenue per order for each of the top 3 countries by number of orders?
sql: WITH country_orders AS (SELECT country, invoice, SUM(revenue) as order_revenue FROM fact_sales GROUP BY country, invoice), country_stats AS (SELECT country, COUNT(invoice) as total_orders, SUM(order_revenue) as total_revenue FROM country_orders GROUP BY country), top_countries AS (SELECT country FROM country_stats ORDER BY total_orders DESC LIMIT 3) SELECT t.country, t.total_revenue / t.total_orders as avg_revenue_per_order FROM country_stats t JOIN top_countries tc ON t.country = tc.country

question: Which calendar month had the highest revenue, and what was it?

question: For each month from February 2011 to November 2011, what was the percentage change in revenue versus the previous month?
sql: WITH monthly_revenue AS (SELECT d.year, d.month, SUM(s.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM fact_sales s JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.year = 2011 AND d.month BETWEEN 1 AND 11 GROUP BY d.year, d.month), revenue_with_lag AS (SELECT year, month, total_revenue, LAG(total_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY year, month) AS prev_month_revenue FROM monthly_revenue) SELECT year, month, ((total_revenue - prev_month_revenue) / NULLIF(prev_month_revenue, 0)) * 100 AS pct_change FROM revenue_with_lag WHERE month >= 2 ORDER BY year, month

question: For each of the 3 countries with the most revenue, what is its single best-selling product by revenue (stock code and revenue)?
sql: WITH country_revenue AS (SELECT country, SUM(revenue) as total_revenue FROM fact_sales GROUP BY country ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 3), product_sales AS (SELECT country, stock_code, SUM(revenue) as product_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY SUM(revenue) DESC) as rank FROM fact_sales WHERE country IN (SELECT country FROM country_revenue) GROUP BY country, stock_code) SELECT country, stock_code, product_revenue FROM product_sales WHERE rank = 1

question: What percentage of total revenue comes from the top 10% of customers by revenue?
sql: WITH customer_revenue AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(revenue) AS total_customer_revenue FROM fact_sales GROUP BY customer_id), ranked_customers AS (SELECT total_customer_revenue, NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY total_customer_revenue DESC) as decile FROM customer_revenue), total_revenue AS (SELECT SUM(total_customer_revenue) as grand_total FROM customer_revenue) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN decile = 1 THEN total_customer_revenue ELSE 0 END) / MAX(grand_total) * 100 AS top_decile_revenue_percentage FROM ranked_customers, total_revenue

question: Among customers who bought in both 2010 and 2011, how many spent less in 2011 than in 2010?
sql: WITH yearly_spend AS (SELECT customer_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) AS yr, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM fact_sales WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) IN (2010, 2011) GROUP BY customer_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)), customer_comparison AS (SELECT customer_id, MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2010 THEN total_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS spend_2010, MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2011 THEN total_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS spend_2011 FROM yearly_spend GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT yr) = 2) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_comparison WHERE spend_2011 < spend_2010

question: By what percentage did revenue in Q1 2011 change compared with Q1 2010?

question: Of the customers who made a purchase in 2010, what percentage also made a purchase in 2011?

question: What was the cumulative (running total) revenue at the end of each month of 2011?
